title: Sportswear HO19 / Zoom 2K window rendering

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Test a campaign in its physical setting because the frame, scale and surroundings change what a passerby notices.
strategic_value: The large shoe and broad white headline can connect Nike product recognition with the shop entrance.
demonstration: A dark storefront rendering contains a wide Zoom 2K collage; the window version uses a different portrait crop and a longer headline than NS01.
practical_value: Judge which image and message remain prominent inside a storefront frame.

content_islands.name: Window artwork
content_islands.spec: Fit the portrait-and-shoe collage inside the large recessed window.

content_islands.name: Message
content_islands.spec: Center the white headline, supporting line and signature toward the lower part of the artwork.

content_islands.name: Retail context
content_islands.spec: Retain the dark facade, pavement and partial store interior to show the display scale.

reference_purposes.Application: A dark storefront rendering contains a wide Zoom 2K collage; the window version uses a different portrait crop and a longer headline than NS01.
